Name: DE-Typologies
Description: Extracts the list of typologies of users.
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.UserTypology)
select  utp.Oid as DocumentOid,
        utp.Oid as TypologyId,
        utp.Name as Typology,
        utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        div.Id as DivisionId,
        div.Name as Division,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        utp.Plannable,
        utp.Active as IsActive,
        utp.HourlyValue
from    UserTypology utp
            left join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = utp.UserTypologyGroup
            left join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = utp.Company
            left join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = utp.Department
            left join DivisionLookup div on div.Id = dep.Division
